title: [CON2-2] `agora_admission_host` is required in DM GroupContexts, but no client is told to support i
description: Review finding CON2-2: `agora_admission_host` is required in DM GroupContexts, but no client is told to support it (lens CON2). Location: spec/05-messaging.md:73 (fix site); spec/04-access-control.md:158. Fix: 04 §4.6 puts 0xF0A0 in `required_capabilities`; 05 §5.2.1 says only "Every Agora client lists 0xF0A1 in its leaf `capabilities`". Under RFC 9420 a leaf lacking a required extension cannot be added. Change to "Every Agora client lists 0xF0A0 and 0xF0A1 in its leaf `capabilities.extensions`." Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
